Name:
⭐ Calvin Harris & Dua Lipa - Dreams [V1]
(prod. Calvin Harris)
Notes:
OG Filename: Calvin Harris x Dua Lipa - Dreams (AT) O 2 (VOCALDEMO) [LoudMaster]
Demo/Remix version. Intended for release in the summer of 2019, as a follow up to 'One Kiss', but was ultimately scrapped from Future Nostalgia because of scheduling issues/due to Dua wanting it to be a solo project. Parts of the song were reworked and reused for 'Lovers in the Past', released in 2024 by Calvin Harris and Rag'n'bone Man. A snippet leaked on June 11th, 2022 by a fan with the caption “I present you an unreleased by Dua Lipa that you will not get anywhere.”. The demo version is longer and has more instrumental parts than vocal parts.
